evidence.why: Scale calculation and restoration.
Callback registration, held-item guards, damage and timed restoration.
Uniform root-joint scale application.

reason: Retain paired hit-scale/restoration names, signatures, scale flow and fighter-owned lifetime. Damage applies the special-times-common scale and starts x8; restoration is guarded by a held item and, in animation processing, positive x8 before decrement. Taking damage restores immediately. Enlargement is the existing gameplay interpretation, not proof that the unexamined attribute multiplier exceeds one in every configuration.
